summary.business_type: Personal portfolio / professional profile with blog
top_findings: Privacy notice says no third-party requests, but the homepage loads widget.zelixai.ai (script, iframe, connect) and has no footer/privacy link
Homepage has almost no crawlable text: h1 is aria-hidden and the only copy is one role line
Turkish content is hidden with display:none in the same URLs; no /tr/ pages or hreflang, while og:locale:alternate and inLanguage claim Turkish
posts/template.html is live, indexable and has placeholder title and no canonical
Blog stalled after 4 posts (last Jul 11, 2026); posts are generic, uncited and have no byline; projects have no on-site write-ups
quick_wins: Disclose or remove the homepage widget and add a footer with a privacy link
Add a visible intro paragraph and accessible h1 to the homepage
Move posts/template.html out of the deployed root or add noindex
Rewrite the six short titles and descriptions
Add alternateName, worksFor and knowsAbout to Person; add dateModified, image, publisher to BlogPosting
summary.limitations: claude-seo Python runtime unavailable (Python 3.9.6); no CWV lab/field data (PageSpeed API 429), no GSC/backlinks/screenshots. Audit done inline with curl and repo source.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS with HSTS; http and apex redirect to https://www in one 301 hop
Self-referencing canonical on every indexable page
robots.txt allows all and lists the sitemap; sitemap has exactly the 11 indexable URLs

findings.title: posts/template.html publicly reachable
findings.description: /posts/template and /posts/template.html return 200 with title 'Post Title', no canonical, no noindex.
findings.recommendation: Move to _templates/ or add noindex.

findings.title: Orphan thanks.html
findings.description: Says the message was sent, but the contact form uses mailto: and never redirects there.
findings.recommendation: Delete or keep noindex.

findings.title: No /favicon.ico
findings.description: Returns 404; only SVG and apple-touch icons are declared.
findings.recommendation: Add a root favicon.ico.

findings.title: Manifest theme_color mismatch
findings.description: site.webmanifest #E9B44C vs meta theme-color #14110E.
findings.recommendation: Align.

findings.title: No response security headers beyond HSTS
findings.description: GitHub Pages cannot set custom headers; CSP is delivered via meta so frame-ancestors is not enforceable.
findings.recommendation: Only relevant if a CDN is added.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Clear, personal writing voice; 327 to 1,896 words per post
Deep-learning and agents posts have useful H2 structure and one-sentence summaries
Experience page has concrete roles, dates, GPA and certificates

findings.title: Homepage is effectively empty of text
findings.description: h1 'BARIS AKINTI' is aria-hidden; only other copy is the role line.
findings.recommendation: Add an accessible h1 and a short intro with links to projects and latest post.

findings.title: Turkish content not indexable
findings.description: Turkish text is hidden via display:none !important in the same documents; no /tr/ URLs, no hreflang, yet og:locale:alternate and inLanguage claim tr.
findings.recommendation: Create /tr/ pages with hreflang, or remove the Turkish claims from OG and schema.

findings.title: Blog stalled and generic
findings.description: 4 posts Jul 1 to Jul 11 2026, none since; head-term topics with no sources and no byline.
findings.recommendation: Write about own projects, cite sources, add bylines, publish monthly.

findings.title: Projects page is thin
findings.description: 8 one-sentence cards all linking off-site to GitHub.
findings.recommendation: Publish 2-3 on-site case studies.

findings.title: Inconsistent identity facts
findings.description: Engineer vs student; 'BSc Artificial Intelligence Systems' vs 'BSc, Machine Learning & AI Systems'.
findings.recommendation: Pick one wording and use it everywhere including schema.

findings.title: Turkish heading typo
findings.description: 'Deep Learnıng vs. Machıne Learnıng' in posts/deep-learning.html.
findings.recommendation: Fix the dotless ı.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique title and description on every page
Complete OG and Twitter tags with a 1200x630 image
One h1 per page; consistent navigation; posts cross-link

findings.title: Thin titles and descriptions on inner pages
findings.description: Titles 19-25 chars ('About | Barış Akıntı'); descriptions 80-99 chars on blog, projects, experience, contact.
findings.recommendation: Use the drafts in ACTION-PLAN.md.

findings.title: Awkward post title
findings.description: 'How Does Machine Learning?' lacks the searched word 'work'.
findings.recommendation: Retitle to 'How Does Machine Learning Work?'.

findings.title: No byline or related-post links
findings.description: Posts show only a date; no author line, no next/related links, no links to projects.
findings.recommendation: Add byline linking to /about and related links.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: WebSite + Person on home, ProfilePage on about, Blog on blog, BlogPosting on all posts
Person has sameAs to GitHub, LinkedIn, Instagram

findings.title: BlogPosting incomplete
findings.description: dateModified and image only on hello-world; no publisher; author lacks @id.
findings.recommendation: Add them and reference #person.

findings.title: Person missing entity properties
findings.description: No alternateName (Baris Akinti), worksFor, knowsAbout; jobTitle says Engineer while pages say student.
findings.recommendation: Add properties and align jobTitle.

findings.title: Blog lacks blogPost list; Experience page has no schema
findings.recommendation: Add blogPost array; optionally mark up Experience.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: About 30 KB CSS, self-hosted fonts, preloaded AVIF hero (20 KB), async 9 KB analytics, image dimensions set

findings.title: No measured data; third-party widget on homepage
findings.description: PageSpeed API quota error and no CrUX/GSC. Score is estimated from source. Homepage loads a deferred third-party widget script.
findings.recommendation: Run PageSpeed Insights on key pages and consider loading the widget on interaction if it affects LCP/INP.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All crawlers allowed; llms.txt present; clear Person entity with sameAs; quotable one-sentence summaries

findings.title: llms.txt and humans.txt out of date
findings.description: llms.txt lists 7 projects, site has 8; humans.txt lists Google Fonts and FormSubmit no longer used and last update 2026/07/06.
findings.recommendation: Refresh both.

findings.title: Privacy notice does not match homepage third-party widget
findings.description: Notice says no requests to third-party servers except analytics; homepage loads widget.zelixai.ai script and iframe and has no footer/privacy link.
findings.recommendation: Disclose or remove the widget and add a footer privacy link.

categories.name: Images
what_works: AVIF/WebP with JPG fallback, responsive srcset, explicit width/height, lazy loading below the fold

findings.title: Alt text inconsistencies
findings.description: Homepage portrait alt uses ASCII 'Baris Akinti'; 'deep learning illustration' is generic and untranslated in the Turkish block.
findings.recommendation: Describe images specifically and translate alt in both languages.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Reconcile privacy notice with homepage widget; add footer/privacy link to index.html
Add visible intro and accessible h1 to homepage
Remove posts/template.html from the deployed root or add noindex
Make identity facts consistent (student vs engineer; degree name)
Fix Turkish typo in deep-learning post

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Rewrite six thin titles and descriptions
Decide Turkish strategy: /tr/ pages with hreflang, or remove Turkish claims from OG/schema
Refresh llms.txt, humans.txt, manifest, favicon.ico; handle thanks.html

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add bylines, related links and cited sources to posts
Resume blogging with posts based on own projects

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Verify Search Console and Bing Webmaster; submit sitemap
Re-run audit or set a drift baseline after Phases 1-2
